description.zh: 是否返回已添加的OSS引用仓库。true为默认值，表示返回；false表示不返回。
description.en:
Specifies whether to return the OSS reference repositories that have already been added. Valid values:

- true (default): Returns the already added repositories.
- false: Does not return the already added repositories.

title.zh: 实例可添加的OSS引用仓库
title.en: OSS reference repositories available for an instance

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch list-alternative-snapshot-repos --instance-id es-cn-0pp1jxvcl000z0000 --already-set-items true --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
